get_supported_xai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI-compatible parameters for a given xAI model
transform_xai_request: transform an xAI chat request by stripping names from messages and mapping parameters
transform_xai_response: transform an xAI API response fixing finish_reason and extracting web search usage data
parse_xai_streaming_chunk: parse an xAI streaming chunk handling empty choices with usage data
get_xai_provider_info: get the OpenAI-compatible API base URL and API key for xAI integration
